exploration_assessment.explanation: Two broad paths were exercised: angle-only trials and combined relocation/reconfiguration of the parented door. Four variants were rendered and read with the same camera; their sequential edits and final reference comparison support qualitative iteration, not a documented formal ranking or isolated attribution of combined changes. No new diagnostic geometry or visibility test was performed.

failure_or_stopping_observations: Final student report acknowledges door silhouette and floor overlap remain too small (SDK event 32).

The four run results report saved scene and render without Python tracebacks; the last stderr contains a Material.use_nodes deprecation warning (evidence/index.json:121-249; executions/blender_1795798616253310228/stderr.log).

No student top or side view, visibility mask, mesh collision measurement, or independent regeneration is present in the SDK trace. Evaluator scene states and target_geometry.json are not student checks.

Final evaluated geometry records the door leaf parented to the hinge and its bounds at target_geometry.json:1160-1170,1914-1972; this establishes geometry, not successful attachment or collision clearance.

candidate_knowledge.problem: A parented door is insufficiently visible in a reconstruction camera.
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: The received hint identifies missing broad foreground door occlusion; the final student report still notes insufficient silhouette and floor overlap.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Teacher suggested a hinge/wall relationship; precise occlusion versus camera projection was not established by the student.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Iterate parent-hinge rotation, then shift the hinge and doorway proxy and reverse/widen the parented leaf and panel geometry while retaining the camera.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: Potentially useful for a camera-visible articulated door assembly; cross-scene transfer is untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Four actual camera renders read; final comparison to reference is qualitative, with a remaining mismatch.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Combined final edit prevents causal isolation; doorway proxy is not an actual wall opening; intersections and attachment were not checked.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Top-view diagnosis, physical clearance and generalization.

limitations: Reference hidden geometry is unavailable; no ground-truth 3D alignment is established.
Teacher diagnosis contains broader proposals than the exact received guidance; proposals are not student actions.
Posthoc scene-state and target-geometry outputs are independent evaluator evidence, not student discovery.
No evidence supports a full-reference image-plane shortcut; the executed source constructs a 3D scene with constant materials.
Sequential render reads and edits support qualitative iteration, but unstated pairwise judgments and hidden reasoning remain unknown.
